E1270

Adapter package could not be realized.

What

Adapter package could not be realized.

Why

`Pkg.adapt(...)` turns source bytes into a normal package, so its string-valued `source:` must be a ref such as `"./vendor/tool"` and its recipe must be one of the supported U20 recipes: `Recipe.copy()`, `Recipe.prebuilt(bin:, as:)`, or finite `Recipe.build(steps: […])` actions (`.fetch`, `.exec`, `.install`, `.install_tree`).

Fix

check the `Pkg.adapt(...)` source and recipe.
